import.title: Import issues from {{tracker}}

hint.github-issues: This is GitHub's own search: add label:bug or author:name. Only issues come out, not pull requests.
hint.gitlab-issues: GitLab searches the text of issues. Only issues come out, not merge requests.

import.failed: Agentry could not read the issues from {{tracker}}.
import.marksNote: The marks come from issue.triage and only help to choose. ready: an agent can start from the issue as written. needs refining: the goal or how to tell it is done is missing. not for agents: it needs a person.
import.untrusted: Each task keeps the issue's title as it is and its text as a quote, “From {{tracker}}”; the agent reads it as data, not as an order.

markTitle.ready: An agent can start from the issue as written.
markTitle.needs-refining: The goal or how to tell it is done is missing.
markTitle.not-for-agents: It needs a person: an access, a decision or something outside the repository.

panel.title: {{tracker}}
panel.intro: Agentry only writes to the tracker, one write per event. A write that fails is shown here and repeated only when you ask.
panel.none: Agentry has not written to this issue yet.
